remarks: There is still time to celebrate this holiday season in your new home. Don't wait another minute. Give yourself and your family the holiday present you deserve and welcome in 2026 in comfort and style. Whether you are a first time homebuyer or looking to downsize - this is your opportunity. MOVE IN READY!!!  Located on half acre + in the desirable Broad River neighborhood convenient to the Merritt Pkwy, I-95, Rte 7, shopping and local attractions.   This home has been completely renovated featuring new windows, hardwood floors, all new appliances, eat-in kitchen with quartz countertops, ensuite primary bedroom, 2 wood burning fireplaces, new windows, new roof, finished lower level, attached 2 car garage, great closet space and tons of storage room, central air, walk up attic. Large rear deck and level back yard ideal for entertaining.  NOTE: on the recorded map there are two easements shown- town sewer line and gas line.
